input.subject: Nico Robin
input.continuity: One Piece manga through the end of Wano Country arc
input.intent: Refine this campaign's newly generated candidate in context.candidateToRefine through the standard generator. Preserve every executable field, name, number, form, Technique and purchase exactly. Change only unit/path/purchase description strings needed to resolve this review. Return the entire valid executable unit, not a patch. Correct the prose contract for purchased contactStun: it applies to every damaging direct attack, including Techniques, not only primary contacts. A boss tag alone does not block this legacy modifier; bosses must have stunnable=false or weakWilled=false. Shared onHit immuneTo boss rules are separate. Describe that distinction consistently in the unit and path descriptions. Do not weaken boss immunity by silently changing enemy assumptions. Do not introduce additional scope or stat changes. Keep all source-supported traits and disclosed adaptation boundaries.

candidateToRefine.name: Nico Robin
candidateToRefine.description: Straw Hat archaeologist; One Piece manga through Wano. Hana Hana limbs blossom directly on targets or surfaces, never travel as bullets. Clutch uses replicated arms for joint locks; Gigante Fleur constructs a giant upper-body duplicate with serpentine grasping limbs; Demonio Fleur constructs a devil-like duplicate for a powerful finishing hold. Neither construction is a new Devil Fruit, awakening or asserted Haki; shaded skin does not establish Armament. All numbers, prices, tier unlocks, repeated attack cycles and bounded geometry are game adaptations, not canon measurements or measured balance. Highest purchased tier unlocks constructions at 3 and 5 on any path. Only one primary operates. Stamina abstracts giant-construction strain; ordinary limb replication is free. Area contacts represent simultaneous separate blossoms, not explosions, and obey reach, visibility, obstacle and cap checks. Holds respect authored eligibility; callers must mark immune bosses non-stunnable/non-slowable or supply the boss tag for shared statuses. Invulnerability remains separate from armor and control. Omitted: reflected limb injuries, defensive interception, disarming enemy weapons, surface space/fire simulation, seawater/seastone exposure, independent body-clone scouting, eyes/ears reconnaissance, flight, ally transport, archaeology and Poneglyph interactions. These omissions grant no substitute economy, ally buffs or detection magic. Giganteum's ceiling-breaking/fire-suppression tactic and Delphinium's rolling displacement are omitted, not renamed damage bonuses. Enemy motion and ally injuries remain caller-supplied.

paths.name: Submission Holds
paths.description: Strengthens the submission-oriented limb attacks. Contact stun is a bounded hold requiring both weakWilled and stunnable, with the runtime protection interval; it is not fear, Haki or guaranteed restraint of every enemy. Control-immune bosses retain their immunity. Each listed duration supersedes smaller purchased contact stuns rather than adding to them.

upgrades.name: Securing Arms
upgrades.description: Primary contacts gain a 0.4-second eligibility-limited hold.

upgrades.name: Tighter Joint Locks
upgrades.description: Add 4 damage to primary attacks and all Techniques, including zero-base-damage Sea Serpent.

upgrades.name: Reinforced Holds
upgrades.description: Raise primary contact holds to 0.8 seconds. Tier 3 also makes Gigante Fleur and its Sea Serpent Technique available through the common unlock schedule.

upgrades.name: Submission Leverage
upgrades.description: Multiply primary and Technique damage by 1.3; useful even when targets cannot be held.

upgrades.name: Sustained Restraint
upgrades.description: Raise primary contact holds to 1.4 seconds and multiply damage by another 1.2. Tier 5 also unlocks Demonio Fleur and Gran Jacuzzi Clutch.

paths.name: Limb Construction
paths.description: Improves the force of replicated and combined limbs, grounded in Robin's larger hands and giant constructions. Damage scaling is an authored abstraction of physical leverage, not internal damage, armor-bypassing Haki or the omitted Giganteum shockwave. Gigante Fleur emphasizes broad grasping; Demonio concentrates its construction into a single-target finishing hold. Gran Jacuzzi's pull toward the duplicate is visual only: this implementation does not displace the target.

upgrades.name: Additional Gripping Arms
upgrades.description: Add 5 damage to primary attacks and all Techniques, including zero-base-damage Sea Serpent.

upgrades.name: Combined Limb Strength
upgrades.description: Multiply primary and Technique damage by 1.2.

upgrades.name: Giant-Limb Leverage
upgrades.description: Add another 10 damage to primary attacks and all Techniques, including zero-base-damage Sea Serpent. The shared tier-3 unlock supplies Gigante Fleur.

upgrades.name: Massed Appendages
upgrades.description: Multiply primary and Technique damage by another 1.4.

upgrades.name: Finishing Construction
upgrades.description: Multiply primary and Technique damage by another 1.6. The shared tier-5 unlock supplies Demonio Fleur; its appearance grants no Haki or fear aura.

paths.name: Bloom Coordination
paths.description: Tunes the delivery reach and cadence of Robin's remotely manipulated limbs, not archaeology or scouting. Range additions extend personal attack eligibility only and never bypass obstacles or concealment. Timing modifiers shorten primary windup and recovery, not Technique timing, stamina costs or cooldown. Clustered area geometry is a bounded interpretation of simultaneous blossoms; caps count enemies, not anatomical limbs.

upgrades.name: Extended Blossoming
upgrades.description: Add 4 reach to the active primary profile and its contextual Technique targeting.

upgrades.name: Wider Placement
upgrades.description: Add another 6 reach. The shared tier-3 unlock provides the broader Gigante Fleur profile without creating a parallel attacker.

upgrades.name: Thousand-Limb Coordination
upgrades.description: Multiply primary timing by another 0.8 and add 4 reach. The shared tier-5 unlock supplies Demonio Fleur; no autonomous clones or scouting bonuses are added.

The supplied ability page contains some later references beyond Wano, including Egghead-era material; those later facts are outside the requested continuity and were not used.
